title: Provable Zeroth-Order Safe Exploration for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.07561v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning from human feedback (Safe-RLHF) seeks to improve helpfulness while satisfying harmlessness constraints. Existing primal-dual approaches can converge to feasible policies but do not prevent constraint violations during training. We study a stronger requirement, safe exploration for RLHF, under which every policy executed during training, including auxiliary exploration policies, remains feasible. We propose Zeroth-Order Log-Barrier Policy Gradient (ZO-LBPG), a reward-model-free method that optimizes a log-barrier objective using zeroth-order estimates derived directly from human preferences. To ensure safety under noisy feedback, we combine conservative constraint margin estimates with coupled rollouts and an adaptive step size that prevents updates from crossing constraint boundaries. We prove that, with high probability, all iterates and exploration policies remain strictly feasible, and that ZO-LBPG globally

translated_title: 基于人类反馈强化学习的可证明零阶安全探索
translated_abstract: 安全的人类反馈强化学习旨在提升模型有用性的同时满足无害性约束。现有的原始-对偶方法虽然可以收敛到可行策略，但无法防止训练过程中的约束违反。我们研究了一个更强的要求——RLHF的安全探索，即训练期间执行的每一个策略（包括辅助探索策略）都必须保持可行。我们提出了零阶对数障碍策略梯度方法（ZO-LBPG），这是一种无需奖励模型的方法，它利用直接从人类偏好中导出的零阶估计来优化对数障碍目标函数。为了在含噪反馈下确保安全性，我们将保守的约束余量估计与耦合的轨迹采样以及自适应步长相结合，以防止更新越过约束边界。我们证明，以高概率，所有迭代过程中的策略和探索策略均保持严格可行，并且ZO-LBPG具有全局（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种无需奖励模型的零阶对数障碍策略梯度方法ZO-LBPG，通过保守约束余量估计、耦合轨迹采样和自适应步长，首次以高概率保证RLHF训练全过程中所有策略（包括探索策略）严格满足安全约束。
en_tdlr: Proposes ZO-LBPG, a reward-model-free zeroth-order log-barrier policy gradient method that, via conservative constraint margins, coupled rollouts, and adaptive step sizes, provably guarantees with high probability that all iterates and exploration policies remain strictly feasible throughout Safe-RLHF training.
